name: Bike Sharing Dataset
description: The Bike Sharing dataset contains hourly and daily counts of rental bikes in the Capital Bikeshare system in Washington D.C. between 2011 and 2012. It includes 17,379 hour-level records paired with corresponding weather (temperature, humidity, windspeed) and seasonal information for regression forecasting.
